**PR #756 merged — roadmap is on main, epic #313 points at it; §0's SHA invariant expires the file on its own merge**

**What**: PR #756 merged at `bb4a58d` (2026-08-20 14:30 UTC); #755 closed. `docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md` is on main. Posted the pointer handoff comment on epic #313: https://github.com/csrinaldi/brain/issues/313#issuecomment-5357323903 — it supersedes the 16/08 and 17/08 handoff comments as the entry point.

**Where**: docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md on main; epic #313 last comment.

**Learned**: The roadmap's §0 lists "`origin/main` es `46fb891`" as an expiry invariant — so by its own rule the file expired the moment it merged (main is now bb4a58d). The handoff doc had the same defect. A SHA is a *measurement timestamp*, not an *invalidating condition*; the conditions that actually invalidate the plan are "M5 has code", "#682 has a terminal PR", "an open PR exists". Candidate follow-up (needs its own issue): split §0 into "medido en" vs "invariantes que invalidan". Not done — out of #755's scope.

**Leftover**: 26 untracked .memory records remain in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755 (worktree NOT removed — removal would delete them; 4 concern #755, the rest #682's sessions). Ship them via `npm run memory:share` in the #682 terminal PR.
